The Amazon Advertising API enables programmatic management of advertising campaigns on Amazon. It provides access to Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns across various marketplaces. Developers can create, manage, and optimize advertising campaigns, access reporting data, and manage budgets and targeting through this REST API.
